description: Open protocol and renderers for agent-generated UI: agents stream declarative JSON, apps render it with native React, Angular, Lit, Flutter (GenUI), SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose components.
rules: Current protocol is v0.9.1 (v1.0 is a release candidate, v0.8 is legacy). Use versioned imports such as @a2ui/react/v0_9 and @a2ui/web_core/v0_9.
On Flutter, use the GenUI SDK: `flutter pub add genui` plus `genui_a2a` for a remote A2A agent. flutter_genui and genui_a2ui are discontinued.
Web renderers need @a2ui/web_core plus one of @a2ui/react, @a2ui/angular or @a2ui/lit.
Agents send declarative JSON that references components from the client's catalog; never generate executable UI code.
